g.title: Terminated: intentional — /quit · operator terminate · idle cleanup
Crashed: abnormal invocation terminal — no user-exit evidence
Stale: presumed gone, unproven — 24h aging · lease lost on restart
Archived: prior generations — a view filter, not a resume gate
Reaper doctrine: an open ask bracket outranks every status branch. A live pane is 'suspect' — mutate nothing.
Resume barriers: continuation dropped · context cleared w/ drop · terminate w/ drop · broker continuation.cleared. The 24h auto-rotate is deliberately NOT a barrier.
